about.heading: AI Virtual Receptionist for HVAC Businesses

sections.subheading: Modern Solutions for Modern HVAC Teams
sections.paragraph: At VirtualAssistant.com.au, we understand that every call to your HVAC business could be an urgent repair, a new installation, or a maintenance request. Our AI Virtual Receptionist ensures every enquiry is answered promptly and professionally.

sections.subheading: Focus on Service, Not Phone Calls

sections.paragraph: Whether your team is busy, after hours, or during peak seasons, your AI Receptionist captures every call. It explains your services — from air conditioning and heating to ventilation and maintenance — and books jobs automatically.
